style.paperTreatment: warm ivory stock, torn edges, halftone ink, soft directional shadows

storyboard.note: User rejected the flat poster-like motion and requested a stronger 20s five-layer assembly, exploded view, collision, and recomposition test.

assets.note: One image-model hero frame; all other assets are local derivatives. No voice, sound, or video provider.

preview.note: V1 was rejected as too close to a moving poster. Motion V2 is the current draft review surface.

scenes.purpose: prove that the approved hero frame can become true layered paper motion
scenes.heroFrame: Warm editorial paper collage with a cream sheet, coral strip, navy arrow, cobalt circle, upper-left negative space for labels.

motion.hero: five source-derived paper layers assemble, explode into depth, reassemble, collide, and settle
motion.secondary: layer ID tags stamp in during the exploded-view beat
